description: Deterministically check a structured extraction against its hand-labelled gold record: schema validity (nullable fields are the abstention contract), field accuracy with per-field normalisers (dates → ISO, money → minor units) and aliases, and fabrication — a non-null value in a field whose gold is null (a guessed date of birth the document never stated). Same logic as the CI gate — no model, no network. Returns pass/fail with named issues and a per-field verdict.

aliases.description: Per-field acceptable alternative gold values (matched after normalisation)

gold.description: The hand-labelled gold record; null means THE DOCUMENT DOES NOT STATE IT — gold's keys define which fields are compared

normalize.description: Per-field normaliser applied to both sides before comparing

record.description: The record the system extracted ({ field: value | null })

schema.description: The JSON Schema the record must validate against (type a must-find field non-nullable, a may-be-absent field nullable)

name: check_extraction
title: Check one extracted record
